tasks.title: Encode binding and unattended-policy decisions in `review-route`
tasks.description: Moves the last policy-sensitive Phase D routing decision out of SKILL prose and into the deterministic router.
acceptance_criteria: `review-route` accepts `unattended_revert_policy: "pause" | "fail-fast" | "preserve-only"` in the payload, defaulting to `"pause"` for backward compatibility.
`codex_review_binding=true` plus Codex or Gemini `needs-rework` on Claude work returns `pause_awaiting_user` with `stage:"post_binding_block"` when policy is `"pause"`.

The same binding branch returns `fail` only when policy is `"fail-fast"` or `"preserve-only"`, and the output carries an explicit `authorization_source` or equivalent machine-readable field for the follow-on `fail-task` path.
D.4 fail/rescue entries are distinguishable from binding-policy entries in the output payload so the SKILL does not have to inspect free-text `fail_reason`.
Tests cover all three policies and assert that no D.5/remediation actions are reachable from the binding branch.
tasks.classification_reason: plan body explicitly mandates codex implementer for every task; classifier verdict overridden

gaps.detail: PLAN_PHASE_D_STATE_MACHINE_COMPLETION.md carries 5 ### TASK-NNN: headings; only the matching one is parsed. This chunk MUST be dispatched with target_task_id set so the renderer auto-injects the disambiguator (TASK-007).
